c-026.logical_sql:
SELECT artist.name AS artist_name,
       SUM(sales_order_line.quantity * sales_order_line.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM product
JOIN sales_order_line ON product.id = sales_order_line.product_id
JOIN album ON product.album_id = album.id
JOIN billing ON sales_order_line.order_number = billing.order_number
               AND sales_order_line.store_code = billing.store_code
JOIN artist ON album.artist_id = artist.id
GROUP BY artist.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
